title: OCPP 2.0.1 frame, charging station → CSMS
description: Validates one complete OCPP-J WebSocket text message that a charging station sends to this CSMS over subprotocol "ocpp2.0.1". Valid frames are [2, messageId, Action, payload] (CALL), [3, messageId, payload] (CALLRESULT answering a CSMS command) or [4, messageId, errorCode, description, details] (CALLERROR). Anything else (non-JSON, wrong array shape, unknown message type, unknown action, extra or mistyped fields, out-of-range values) does not validate. Generated by `npm run specs` from specs/src/schemas.ts. Do not edit by hand.
